name: compliance-foundry-task-board
description: Multi-tenant project-management platform (take-home): Postgres schema, Node GraphQL API, React task board.

scripts.setup: npm run db:migrate -w api && npm run db:seed -w api
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run db:codegen -w api -- --verify && npm run gql:codegen -w api -- --check && npm run gql:codegen -w web -- --check && npm test
